ConnectionStrings.//: Managed identity: no password, so this is configuration rather than a secret. Supplied by the Helm ConfigMap (api.config.connectionString). Shape: Server=tcp:<server>.database.windows.net,1433;Initial Catalog=<db>;Authentication=Active Directory Default;Encrypt=True;

Auth.//BootstrapAdminEmail: One-time link so somebody can sign in on a fresh database (ADR-0058). Inert once any person has an email. Left empty in production, where linking belongs on Settings -> People.
